title: The .LLab Succession Quest™
intro: A free quest for every member. Drawn from The .LLab Knowledge Transfer Checklist™ and The .LLab Continuity Quick-Check™: what must stay true when leadership changes, who could carry each role, how the handover is practiced, and where the succession record lives.

nodes.section: Phase I · What must stay true
nodes.prompt: What must stay true about this organization when its leadership changes?

nodes.section: Phase I · What must stay true
nodes.prompt: Which values or commitments would the people you serve notice first if a new leader dropped them?

nodes.section: Phase I · What must stay true
nodes.prompt: What does a good successor need to believe about the work, not only know how to do?

nodes.section: Phase II · Who carries each role
nodes.prompt: Which three roles or responsibilities would hurt most if their holder left tomorrow?

nodes.section: Phase II · Who carries each role
nodes.prompt: For each of those roles, who is the successor or backup today, and how ready are they (ready now, within a year, not yet)?

nodes.section: Phase II · Who carries each role
nodes.prompt: Which decisions, relationships or logins sit with one person and need a second holder?

nodes.section: Phase III · How the handover is practiced
nodes.prompt: How will each successor practice the role before they need it: shadowing, running a meeting, making a decision with support?

nodes.section: Phase III · How the handover is practiced
nodes.prompt: Which knowledge will you capture as part of normal work each week, rather than at the moment someone leaves?

nodes.section: Phase III · How the handover is practiced
nodes.prompt: How will you introduce successors to the clients, partners, volunteers or community members who rely on the role?

nodes.section: Phase IV · Where the succession record lives
nodes.prompt: Where will the succession record live, and who besides you can open it?

nodes.section: Phase IV · Where the succession record lives
nodes.prompt: When will the plan be reviewed each year, and what change in the organization would trigger an early review?

nodes.section: Phase IV · Where the succession record lives
nodes.prompt: What would you want the next leader to protect above all, and what would you want them free to change?

closing.prompt: The first succession step I will take, who it involves, and by when:
